mapper.select: SELECT h.hobby_id::TEXT AS db_key, h.hobby_nm, h.summary, dc.code_nm AS difficulty_nm FROM t_hobby h LEFT JOIN t_code dc ON dc.code_id = h.difficulty_cd AND dc.p_code_id = 'HOBBYLV00' WHERE h.use_yn = 'Y' AND (h.hobby_nm LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR h.summary LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%') ORDER BY h.sort_ordr, h.hobby_id LIMIT 10

SELECT r.recruit_id::TEXT AS db_key, r.title, r.region, r.meet_dt, r.status_cd, ho.hobby_nm, sc.code_nm AS status_nm FROM t_recruit r LEFT JOIN t_hobby ho ON ho.hobby_id = r.hobby_id LEFT JOIN t_code sc ON sc.code_id = r.status_cd AND sc.p_code_id = 'RECRUIT00' WHERE r.use_yn = 'Y' AND (r.title LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR r.content LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%') ORDER BY r.recruit_id DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT b.bbs_id::TEXT AS db_key, b.bbsinfo_id, b.title, (SELECT u.nickname FROM t_user u WHERE u.user_id = b.reg_id) AS reg_nm, bi.bbsinfo_nm, TO_CHAR(b.reg_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS reg_dt FROM t_bbs b LEFT JOIN t_bbsinfo bi ON bi.bbsinfo_id = b.bbsinfo_id WHERE b.use_yn = 'Y' AND b.p_bbs_id = 0 AND b.secret_yn = 'N' AND b.title LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t_hobby h WHERE h.bbsinfo_id = b.bbsinfo_id AND h.use_yn = 'Y') ORDER BY b.bbs_id DESC LIMIT 10
